speaker: Doctor
text: Do you currently have any discharge from your penis, and have you experienced any eye irritation or redness recently? Given your history and symptoms, I will need to order some tests to confirm the source of the infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, STD Panel, HLA-B27, and Joint Aspiration.

text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows WBC 12–16/hpf with negative protein and blood. ELISA for HIV is Negative. speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your knee swelling, eye inflammation, and urinary symptoms strongly suggests Reactive Arthritis, but I need to confirm the underlying infection. Do you recall having any recent diarrhea or gastrointestinal upset, and have you noticed any skin lesions or patches on the soles of your feet or palms of your hands?

speaker: Doctor
text: Your anxiety is noted, but given the strong clinical triad of urethritis, conjunctivitis, and asymmetric arthritis, the diagnosis is likely Reactive Arthritis triggered by a recent infection. I will proceed with a final assessment based on the current evidence. DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome)
